fields.name: Request type
fields.description: 0000=reserved, 0001=NAS signalling connection release, 0010=Rejection of paging, all other values reserved. Bits 5-8 are spare and shall be coded as zero

notes: Request type (bits 4 to 1 of octet 3): 0000=reserved, 0001=NAS signalling connection release, 0010=Rejection of paging
Bits 5 to 8 of octet 3 are spare and shall be coded as zero
